taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 19.07 – 20.11 m (low-resistivity layer, ~60 ohm-m, sandwiched between higher-resistivity units)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement around the 19–20 m interval where the conductive zone indicates probable saturated/clay-rich material; confirm lithology with cuttings/logging during drilling and case off the overlying variable-resistivity layers (18–19 m) to prevent borehole instability.
